state: persistent GRU hidden state plus latent array
clock: 10 Hz aligned pilot clock; nearest native timestamps from pinned MuQ layer 9 remain physical seconds
body: saved native-C world positions converted to root-relative coordinates; no body generation
color: bounded OKLab field head; RGB is a diagnostic projection only
motion: body-effort gated jerk proposal followed by bounded dynamics projection
fixture_equivariance: metadata shared per fixture, no fixture index embedding
